_comment: Mutations that break the SERVER half of the Google sign-in, one at a time.
Every mutation must be caught by tests/test_google_signin_security.py.
This spec has a pytest target, so it runs on the harness's pytest path:
the verdict comes from the pytest SUMMARY, exactly as for every other
spec. (The front-end half of the same flow is a separate spec with a
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: S1: the credential is logged again, in full
mutations.needle:
logger.warning(
            "Failed to verify Google token (sha256:%s): %s",
            token_digest[:16],
            type(e).__name__,
        )

mutations.label: S2: the exception message is logged, and it carries the credential
mutations.needle:
type(e).__name__,
        )
        audit_logger.login_failed(
            username=f"google_{token_digest[:12]}",
            ip_address=get_client_ip(request),
            user_agent=get_user_agent(request),
            reason="Invalid Google token",
mutations.replace:
f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}",  # MUTANT: the message carries the credential
        )
        audit_logger.login_failed(
            username=f"google_{token_digest[:12]}",
            ip_address=get_client_ip(request),
            user_agent=get_user_agent(request),
            reason="Invalid Google token",

mutations.label: S3: the audit log gets a PREFIX of the credential again
mutations.needle:
username=f"google_{token_digest[:12]}",
            ip_address=get_client_ip(request),
            user_agent=get_user_agent(request),
            reason="Invalid Google token",
mutations.replace:
username=f"google_{payload.token[:10]}...",  # MUTANT: a prefix is audited
            ip_address=get_client_ip(request),
            user_agent=get_user_agent(request),
            reason="Invalid Google token",

mutations.label: S4: the attempt is never consumed, so a replay is accepted
mutations.needle:
if not await google_signin.consume_once(db, consumed_values):
        audit_logger.login_failed(
            username=f"google_{token_digest[:12]}",
            ip_address=get_client_ip(request),
            user_agent=get_user_agent(request),
            reason="Google sign-in attempt already used",
        )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="This sign-in has already been used. Please sign in again.",
        )
mutations.replace: # MUTANT: the attempt is never consumed, so a replay is accepted

mutations.label: S5: the credential itself is not consumed, only the one-time value
mutations.replace: consumed_values = []  # MUTANT: the credential itself is not consumed

mutations.label: S6: the client one-time value is not consumed
mutations.replace: # MUTANT: the client one-time value is not consumed

mutations.label: S7: a value that was already consumed is accepted again
mutations.needle:
except IntegrityError:
        # One of the values was already consumed. This attempt is a replay.
        await db.rollback()
        return False
mutations.replace:
except IntegrityError:
        # One of the values was already consumed. This attempt is a replay.
        await db.rollback()
        return True  # MUTANT: a replay is accepted
